competitors.title:
Short Summary:

> Privacy-First Infrastructure: Prividium, is live and already onboarding traditiona
competitors.description:
Short Summary:

> Privacy-First Infrastructure: Prividium, is live and already onboarding traditional institutions that cannot expose transaction flows to competitors or regulators in real time.

> Full-Stack Partnership with BitGo: ZKsync teams up with BitGo to offer banks a one-stop bundle: tokenization engine, permissioned chain with privacy and regulated custody, all under a single integration.

> Regulatory Traction: Five regional U.S. banks (Cari Network) chaired by a former OCC head are building on Prividium, signaling regulator comfort and accelerating production deployments this year.

> Interoperability Goal: Rather than a closed system, ZKsync is designed to bridge both private and public chains, letting banks move assets and data across ecosystems without sacrificing confidentiality.

> No Single “Magic Bullet”: The team acknowledges that privacy is multi-layered; their approach combines zk-proofs with hardware isolation and permissioned networking, with more hardening expected as adoption scales.

> Immediate Commercial Availability: Unlike many POCs, the infrastructure is marketed as production-ready now, with real bank pilots moving from experimentation to live settlements throughout 2026.
